standards.name: LINCS Other Reagents Metadata Specification
standards.abstract: This specification defines metadata for non-perturbagen auxiliary reagents (e.g., stains, buffers) used in LINCS biomedical assays. The recording modality is tabular metadata describing reagent identity, provider and batch identifiers, and free-text comments. The document is a LINCS (Library of Integrated Network-based Cellular Signatures) metadata specification used/maintained by LINCS Data and Signature Generation Centers (DSGCs) to standardize how "other reagents" are described and registered across centers, addressing reproducibility and harmonized reporting of reagent provenance and identifiers.

classification.rationale: Source material is presented as a concrete metadata table: it lists named fields (OR_Name, OR_Center_Canonical_ID, etc.) with descriptions, a 'Related to' column, comments, and an importance ranking. Each row is a distinct data field with its own concrete format (identifier/name/catalog number), so the standard is a table rather than prose guidance or a process DAG.

OR_Name.descr: Canonical Common name of the reagent (e.g., Hoescht, DAPI). Batch-independent name.
OR_Name.evidence: OR_Name Canonical Common name of the reagent (Hoescht, DAPI, etc.) Should correspond to existing names as much as possible; Batch independent name 1
